1.explanation:
1. NameValueList/README.md – describes the API for column layout and valueProps, so we can see how alignment is handled.
2. NameValueList/stories/CustomThemed – a live example of column mode and valueProps.align to reproduce the misalignment.
3. NameValuePair/README.md – shows how the name and value components are wrapped (likely in Box) and laid out.
4. Box/README.md – documents the align and justify options used internally to position children, critical for understanding why the label and value aren’t vertically centered.
5. Select/README.md – details the Select control’s structure, padding and internal alignment of the displayed option that may affect its vertical position.
6. Text/README.md – explains default line-height and alignment for Text elements (used for the name), needed to adjust or override for proper centering.
1.bug_scenario: The user is trying to render a NameValuePair in “column” mode—with the name (“File log level”) on top and a Select control below—but the label text and the select’s placeholder/value are not vertically centered within the same horizontal band. In the screenshot, the green line marks the baseline of the Text label, the red line marks the baseline of the Select control’s displayed value, and the black arrow indicates the offset between them. The aim is to have both the Text label and the Select control value align to the same vertical center when valueProps={{ align: 'start' }} is used.
